endpoint authors.list {
  route: GET "/authors"
  output: [Author]
}

endpoint authors.get {
  route: GET "/authors/[id]"
  output: Author
  errors: not_found
}

endpoint authors.create {
  route: POST "/authors"
  input: { name: string(max 80), born: date }
  output: Author
  errors: invalid_input
}

endpoint authors.update {
  route: PATCH "/authors/[id]"
  input: { name: string(max 80), born: date } (all optional)
  output: Author
  errors: not_found, invalid_input
}

endpoint authors.delete {
  route: DELETE "/authors/[id]"
  errors: not_found, in_use
}

endpoint authors.books {
  route: GET "/authors/[id]/books"
  output: [Book]
  errors: not_found
}

endpoint books.list {
  route: GET "/books"
  output: [Book]
}

endpoint books.get {
  route: GET "/books/[id]"
  output: Book
  errors: not_found
}

endpoint books.create {
  route: POST "/books"
  input: { title: string(max 120), genre: Genre, published: date, in_print: bool, author_id: Author.id }
  output: Book
  errors: invalid_input
}

endpoint books.update {
  route: PATCH "/books/[id]"
  input: { title: string(max 120), genre: Genre, published: date, in_print: bool, author_id: Author.id } (all optional)
  output: Book
  errors: not_found, invalid_input
}

endpoint books.delete {
  route: DELETE "/books/[id]"
  errors: not_found
}
